label: Gateway
info:
Node -> gateway -> cloud. Subscribes to the local planters/+/telemetry, validates the body against the generated JSON Schema and republishes it unchanged under gateways/<gatewayId>/planters/<sensorKey>/telemetry.

The schema is not edited here. The source of truth is libs/shared/src/lib/metrics.ts; `pnpm contract:gen` generates infra/nodered/contract/ from it and docker-compose mounts that at /contract.

GATEWAY_ID and the broker credentials come from the environment. Until the API implements pairing they are set by hand in .env.
